testdescription: Control point: invoke ordinary typed queries only through public getSystemArchitecture(query) against aligned, disabled, pending, partial, stale, failed, and mismatched durable states; invoke omitted-query and graph-tidy controls. Observation point: each ordinary query freshly verifies readiness before provider/vector work; non-Aligned states reject with fullSnapshotFallback:false; Aligned performs qualified embedding and independent exhaustive Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View vector retrieval followed by deterministic closure and canonical completion; no public readiness tool, injected retrieval boundary, synthetic empty seeds, or fallback exists; omitted-query and graph-tidy perform zero semantic operations.

Control point: after successful canonical mutation with injected provider, persistence, partial-channel, and queryability failures, invoke getSystemArchitecture(query) repeatedly in disabled, Pending, partial, Stale, Failed, unknown, version-mismatched, and Aligned states; then run valid resumable argo init reconciliation and repeat. Invoke no-argument and graph-tidy controls throughout. Observation point: every semantic query freshly reads persistent readiness before provider/vector work, each non-Aligned state rejects with exact redacted state/version/channel evidence and fullSnapshotFallback:false, canonical JSON remains authoritative, no false readiness occurs, later full three-channel reconciliation alone restores Aligned, and no-argument plus graph-tidy retain exact canonical bypass behavior.
